legend: You are given an array of positive integers A$$$A$$$ of size n$$$n$$$. In one operation, you may perform the following:
Choose any indices i,j$$$i, j$$$ such that 1≤i,j≤n$$$1 \le i, j \le n$$$,
Choose a positive integer p$$$p$$$ that divides Ai$$$A_i$$$, formally, p∣Ai$$$p \mid A_i$$$,
After performing the operation any number of times (possibly zero), the final array must satisfy the following requirements, one from each of your three friends:
Muhaimin wants at least a$$$a$$$ elements to be evenly even. A positive integer is called evenly even if it has no odd prime factor.
Noshin wants at least b$$$b$$$ elements to be oddly odd. A positive integer is called oddly odd if it has no even prime factor.

Osman wants the whole array to be balanced. An array is called balanced if each element of the array is either evenly even, or oddly odd, or both. For example, [4, 27] is a balanced array, while [6, 9] is not.
Determine the minimum total cost required to satisfy all three requirements. It can be proved that it is always possible to satisfy all three requirements.
input: The first line of the input contains a single integer t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤500)$$$(1 \le t \le 500)$$$ — the number of test cases.

The first line of each test case contains three space-separated integers n$$$n$$$, a$$$a$$$ and b$$$b$$$ (2≤n≤2⋅105,1≤a, b≤(n−1),2≤a+b≤n)$$$(2 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5, 1 \le a, \space b \le (n - 1), 2 \le a + b \le n)$$$ — the size of the array, the minimum required number of evenly even elements and the minimum required number of oddly odd elements respectively.
The third line of each test case contains n$$$n$$$ integers A1,A2,…,An$$$A_1, A_2, \dots, A_n$$$ (1≤Ai≤106)$$$(1 \le A_i \le 10^6)$$$ — the elements of the array initially.
It is guaranteed that the sum of n$$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed 2⋅105$$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$.
output: For each test case, print a single integer in a line — the minimum total cost required to make the array balanced with at least a$$$a$$$ evenly even and at least b$$$b$$$ oddly odd elements.
note: In the second test case, we can choose i=2$$$i = 2$$$, j=1$$$j = 1$$$ and p=4$$$p = 4$$$ (divide A2$$$A_2$$$ by 4$$$4$$$ and multiply A1$$$A_1$$$ by 4$$$4$$$), resulting in the array [32,1,4]$$$[32, 1, 4]$$$.

legend.ai: 给定一个大小为 n$$$n$$$ 的正整数数组 A$$$A$$$。一次操作中，你可以执行以下操作：
选择任意下标 i,j$$$i, j$$$，满足 1≤i,j≤n$$$1 \le i, j \le n$$$，
选择一个能整除 Ai$$$A_i$$$ 的正整数 p$$$p$$$，形式化地说，即 p∣Ai$$$p \mid A_i$$$，
执行任意次该操作（也可以一次都不执行）后，最终数组必须满足以下要求，这些要求分别来自你的三位朋友：
Muhaimin 希望至少有 a$$$a$$$ 个元素是偶偶数。若一个正整数没有奇素因子，则称其为偶偶数。
Noshin 希望至少有 b$$$b$$$ 个元素是奇奇数。若一个正整数没有偶素因子，则称其为奇奇数。
Osman 希望整个数组是平衡的。如果数组中的每个元素要么是偶偶数，要么是奇奇数，或者同时满足两者，则称该数组是平衡的。例如，[4, 27] 是平衡数组，而 [6, 9] 不是。
确定满足全部三个要求所需的最小总费用。可以证明，总能满足全部三个要求。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含一个整数 t$$$t$$$(1≤t≤500)$$$(1 \le t \le 500)$$$ —— 测试用例的数量。

每个测试用例的第一行包含三个以空格分隔的整数 n$$$n$$$、a$$$a$$$ 和 b$$$b$$$(2≤n≤2⋅105，1≤a, b≤(n−1)，2≤a+b≤n)$$$(2 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5, 1 \le a, \space b \le (n - 1), 2 \le a + b \le n)$$$ —— 数组的大小、偶偶数元素所需的最少数量以及奇奇数元素所需的最少数量。
每个测试用例的第三行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个整数 A1,A2,…,An$$$A_1, A_2, \dots, A_n$$$(1≤Ai≤106)$$$(1 \le A_i \le 10^6)$$$ —— 数组初始时的元素。
保证所有测试用例中 n$$$n$$$ 的总和不超过 2⋅105$$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，输出一个整数，表示使数组平衡所需的最小总花费，即数组中至少有 a$$$a$$$ 个偶数和至少有 b$$$b$$$ 个奇数。
